//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Fire Spread Tweaks -> Config

Enable Fire Spread Tweaks.//: Whether Fire Spread Tweaks is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

timeFireBurnsInTicks.//: The time a fire will keep burning for in ticks. 20 ticks = 1 second. min: 0, max: 72,000

enableRandomizedFireDuration.//: When enabled, uses the MinRandomExtraBurnTicks and MaxRandomExtraBurnTicks config values to randomize the time fire burns for.

MinRandomExtraBurnTicks.//: If randomized fire duration is enabled, a random tick number will be chosen in between the minimum and maximum value. This will be added to timeFireBurnsInTicks. If the outcome is negative, it will be subtracted. min: -36,000, max: 0
